metadata.title: Tepotinib therapy
metadata.indication: Adults with advanced MET exon 14 skipping NSCLC requiring systemic therapy after immunotherapy and/or platinum-based chemotherapy; validated METex14 test, no activating EGFR mutation or ALK rearrangement.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

limitations: NCCP expects no renal dose adjustment below CrCl 30 mL/min or on haemodialysis; current SmPC says severe renal use is not recommended because unstudied. Consultant/pharmacy reconciliation required.
NCCP and SmPC do not specify a CTCAE edition for the dose-modification table; no automatic v5 label.
VISION includes first-line patients, but NCCP 00823a and EU indication are after immunotherapy and/or platinum chemotherapy.
Bilirubin and absence of cholestasis/haemolysis are essential to the combined liver permanent-stop pathway.

metadata.schedule_summary: The usual starting dose is 450 mg once daily: two 225 mg tablets taken together with food. Treatment is continuous, without a planned rest week, while it is helping. Follow your prescribed dose; the team may use one 225 mg tablet or pause treatment for side effects.

met_ex14_validated.label: MET exon 14 skipping confirmed by a validated test?

active_cns_metastases.label: Active CNS metastases?
active_cns_metastases.assessment_guidance: NCCP exclusion; stable treated CNS disease must be distinguished clinically.

ild_suspected.label: Interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis suspected?
ild_suspected.assessment_guidance: Withhold and promptly investigate. A new lung symptom or grade must not be treated as a confirmed diagnosis.

ild_confirmed.label: Interstitial lung disease confirmed?
ild_confirmed.assessment_guidance: Confirmed disease of any grade triggers permanent discontinuation.

cholestasis_or_haemolysis_absent.label: Cholestasis and haemolysis both excluded?
cholestasis_or_haemolysis_absent.assessment_guidance: Required for the source combined ALT/AST >3 ×ULN plus bilirubin >2 ×ULN permanent-stop pathway. Unknown is not yes.

total_bilirubin_increased.label: Total bilirubin increased for this liver event?
total_bilirubin_increased.assessment_guidance: Use alongside the numeric bilirubin result; conflicting evidence must be reviewed. The isolated ALT/AST table applies without increased total bilirubin.

liver_hold_isolated_alt_event.label: Tepotinib held for the source isolated ALT/AST >5–20 ×ULN event?
liver_hold_isolated_alt_event.assessment_guidance: Confirm this was without increased bilirubin and that no permanent-stop criterion was met.

alt_ast_recovered_to_baseline.label: ALT/AST recovered to the patient’s baseline after the hold?
alt_ast_recovered_to_baseline.assessment_guidance: This is not synonymous with returning below 5 ×ULN.

liver_recovery_days.label: Days from withholding to ALT/AST recovery to baseline

other_toxicity_held.label: Temporary interruption for other grade ≥3 adverse reaction?
other_toxicity_held.assessment_guidance: The source allows consideration of an interruption of no more than 21 days; it does not prescribe automatic permanent stopping on day 22.

other_toxicity_hold_days.label: Days of interruption for the other adverse reaction

other_toxicity_recovered_le2.label: Other adverse reaction recovered to grade 2 or lower?

current_tepotinib_dose_mg.label: Current or most recent authorised daily tepotinib dose

tepotinib_crcl_ml_min.label: Creatinine clearance for renal source boundary

renal_input.reason: NCCP and SmPC have a clinically material difference at CrCl <30 mL/min; preserve this boundary and reconcile specialist advice. This is not Calvert dosing.

creatinine_increased_on_treatment.label: Creatinine has increased during tepotinib treatment?
creatinine_increased_on_treatment.assessment_guidance: Tepotinib can inhibit tubular creatinine secretion. Further assessment must distinguish this effect from true renal impairment; do not assume either.

qtc_risk_or_prolongation.label: QTc prolongation or relevant QT risk (electrolytes / concomitant medicines)?
qtc_risk_or_prolongation.assessment_guidance: ECG and electrolytes as clinically indicated. NCCP does not supply an automatic tepotinib QTc dose threshold.

pgp_narrow_therapeutic_index_substrate.label: Sensitive P-gp substrate with narrow therapeutic index?
pgp_narrow_therapeutic_index_substrate.assessment_guidance: Review dabigatran, digoxin and other relevant medicines; dose adjustment/monitoring of the concomitant medicine may be needed.

sensitive_bcrp_substrate.label: Sensitive BCRP substrate taken concurrently?
sensitive_bcrp_substrate.assessment_guidance: Review and monitor adverse effects of medicines such as rosuvastatin, methotrexate or topotecan.

metformin_use.label: Metformin taken concurrently?
metformin_use.assessment_guidance: Monitor its clinical effects because of potential transporter interaction.

eligibility: NCCP 00823a: advanced METex14 NSCLC after immunotherapy and/or platinum chemotherapy.
Validated MET exon 14 skipping alteration; no activating EGFR mutation or ALK rearrangement.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to tepotinib or its excipients.
monitoring: Baseline and regular FBC, electrolytes, renal and liver profile; liver enzymes and bilirubin before starting and thereafter as clinically indicated.
ECG as clinically indicated, particularly with QTc risk or interacting medicines.
Pregnancy test before treatment and during treatment as clinically indicated.
Review respiratory symptoms, oedema, weight/functional impact, bowel symptoms, adherence and concomitant medicines. Further renal assessment for creatinine rise.
Disease monitoring according to the supervising Consultant’s treatment plan.
dose_modifications: Recommended source reduction level is 225 mg daily; all modifications require Consultant discussion.
Suspected ILD: withhold; confirmed ILD of any grade: permanently discontinue.
Liver rules retain bilirubin, cholestasis/haemolysis and recovery-to-baseline qualifiers; the seven-day recovery boundary applies to the isolated >5–20 ×ULN event.
Other grade ≥3 adverse reactions: reduce to 225 mg until grade ≤2; a temporary interruption up to 21 days may be considered. No automatic re-escalation or lower dose is specified.
CrCl <30 mL/min / haemodialysis: reconcile NCCP expected no adjustment with current SmPC not-recommended severe renal use. Child–Pugh C is not recommended.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP 00823 v2 page 3 names minimal-to-low oral emetic risk; NCCP V6 Table 5 uses individual as-needed antiemetics.

treatment_phases.label: Daily tepotinib monotherapy
treatment_phases.duration_note: Continuous daily treatment while clinical benefit is observed; no planned chemotherapy cycle or rest week. The source reduction level is 225 mg daily, subject to Consultant review.

use_with_caution: Existing ILD or ILD-like adverse reactions.
QTc risk, electrolyte disturbance or concomitant QT-prolonging medicines.
Severe renal impairment or dialysis: NCCP/SmPC discrepancy requires individual specialist reconciliation.
